rules: no mocks or route interception in live E2E
effects verified by readback from owning service

cases.requirement: Create a bundle from apps, edit it (edit_revision+reason), validate, publish; unsupported feature rejected
cases.evidence: saved record + digest readback; browser; rejection response

cases.requirement: Plan with term, billing period, prices, included/optional branches; incomplete plan cannot publish
cases.evidence: browser display + API readback; publish rejection

cases.requirement: Customer quote and private customer terms; breakdown from server; 0/null/legacy explicit; other customer unchanged
cases.evidence: quote breakdown JSON; control DB readback; other-customer GET

cases.requirement: Select -> confirm subscription -> SIMULATED payment -> provision -> invitation -> login
cases.evidence: linked quote/order/invoice/attempt/job/tenant IDs; Odoo readback; Mailpit; browser login
manual_or_blocked_candidates: invitation e-mail only captured by Mailpit; real SMTP delivery BLOCKED

cases.requirement: Shared services, apps and quotas: users/permissions/identity/search/attachments, app on/off, limits incl. 0 and unlimited
Branches: HQ free; one free extra; two paid extras = 1000 SAR + VAT; real branch bindings
Mid-cycle branch add with injected billing clock: 500*15/31 = 241.94 before VAT; next price matches
Concurrent requests for last free branch and resends: no double grant, branch, invoice or charge; conflict then requote
cases.evidence: parallel API responses; DB uniqueness counts

cases.requirement: Change bundle/plan/limit: diff preview, target revision, service check; unsafe downgrade rejected; records/attachments kept
cases.evidence: preview JSON; Odoo readback; attachment sha256

cases.requirement: Public price change and bundle withdrawal: old invoice/terms preserved; new-sale eligibility; old job re-run works
cases.evidence: invoice before/after; eligibility API; job replay

cases.requirement: Payment and renewal: success/decline/cancel/timeout/duplicate/out-of-order/wrong-amount/invalid-signature (SIMULATED); one invoice per period; past_due per policy
manual_or_blocked_candidates: real Moyasar sandbox not exercised; simulator only

cases.requirement: Worker crash before/after effect: resume by observation; no false success; payment compensation recorded
cases.evidence: control-worker stop/start; job/outbox readback; Odoo effect readback
manual_or_blocked_candidates: needs docker stop of control-worker of this project only

cases.requirement: Company/branch isolation with real IDs of the other company: API, file, image, search, status/invoice, forged host
cases.evidence: HTTP statuses; byte non-disclosure; screenshots as support only

cases.requirement: Real DB+filestore backup and restore to isolated target; reconcile current subscription before opening
cases.evidence: bytes/rows fingerprints; login; reconciliation report; no duplicate branch/invoice

cases.requirement: Vendor and customer pages: loading/empty/error/forbidden/success; direct URL/refresh/back; 390/768/1440; ar/en/RTL/keyboard
Legacy migration and non_saas: legacy continues, policy/history identical, no price invented; non_saas works without subscription or payment provider
cases.evidence: migrate-saas-commercial dry-run/run twice; counts/hash; non_saas Odoo readback
